openwrt_wiki.seriell: The device has two pinheaders with serial ports. Both ports operate at 3.3V level, 115200 Baud, 8N1 and have the pinout +3,3V - RX - TX - GND. The port to the left (shown red) gives access to U-Boot and OpenWrt's console. The purpose of the other port (shown blue) is not identified yet. Using the default/factory U-Boot environment there are no outputs from the kernel during booting. Instead, one has to send a newline at 9600 Baud (to activate the console) and then login at 115200 Baud again. (Abschnitt Serial console, Foto AC Lite)
openwrt_wiki.leds: The UniFi AP AC has two LEDs (ubnt:white:dome, ubnt:blue:dome)
openwrt_wiki.reset: Pushing and holding down the reset button (either on the device itself or on the PoE injector) while powering up ... after about 5 seconds the blue LED will light up and U-Boot erases the cfg-partition ... keeping the button pushed for additional 8 seconds ... TFTP server on its default IP 192.168.1.20 (nur signierte Herstellerfirmware)
openwrt_wiki.installation: Non-invasive method using dd / mtd (per SSH auf Stock-Firmware), Using U-Boot with serial console (tftpboot, erase 0x9f070000), OEM-TFTP-Recovery nur für signierte Ubiquiti-Firmware
openwrt_wiki.mesh_hinweis: As of OpenWrt 19.07 802.11s meshing is broken on Qualcomm AC Wave1 chipsets ... firmware made by Candela Technologies (-ct firmware and kmod) ... normal upstream firmware and kmod (without -ct) must be installed
openwrt_wiki.oem_firmware: Some of the firmwares are used for several models (UAP-AC-Lite, UAP-AC-LR, UAP-AC-Pro, UAP-AC-EDU, UAP-AC-M, UAP-AC-M-PRO, UAP-AC-IW, UAP-AC-IW-Pro, UAP-AC-UK-Ultra). Firmware-Dateien BZ.qca956x....bin

openwrt_git_ar71xx.text: The device is a hardware clone of the AC Pro. - SoC: QCA9563-AL3A (775Mhz) - RAM: 128MiB - Flash: 16MiB - dual firmware partitions! - LAN: 2x 1000M - POE+ - Wireless: 2.4G: QCA9563 5G: UniFi Chip, QCA988X compatible

openwrt_git_ath79.titel: ath79: add support for UniFi AC-Mesh Pro
openwrt_git_ath79.text: The Unifi AC-Mesh Pro has identical hardware to the Unifi AC-Pro except USB support. Furthermore for setting parameters like antenna gain it is helpful to know the exact device variant.

openwrt_git_portmap.titel: ath79: align Ubiquiti AC Pro ethernet map to factory
openwrt_git_portmap.text: The Uniquiti AC Pro and Ubiquiti AC Mesh Pro currently have the "Primary" and "Secondary" ethernet ports configured to offer LAN as well as WAN. However, Uiquiti describes ...: Secondary UniFi Access Point (UAP) Ethernet ports don't provide PoE passthrough (to run current to a second powered device), but they do support data passthrough. It serves as a bridged interface between main / secondary Ethernet port. ... configure both ports to offer LAN functionality.
